features.name: Strengthened Transformation
features.description:
At 2nd level, you can choose a beast with CR up to 1 when you use Wild Shape (following normal movement restrictions). At 3rd level and beyond, you can choose beasts with CR up to 1/3 your druid level (rounded down).

| Level | Max CR | Limitations | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1 | No flying or swimming speed | Brown bear |
| 4 | 1 | No flying speed | Giant octopus |
| 6 | 2 | No flying speed | Rhinoceros |
| 8 | 2 | — | Giant vampire bat |
| 9 | 3 | — | Killer whale |
| 12 | 4 | — | Elephant |
| 15 | 5 | — | Giant crocodile |
| 18 | 6 | — | Mammoth |

features.name: Resilient Transformation
features.description: When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you can use Wild Shape as a bonus action instead of an action. While in beast form, you can expend a spell slot as a bonus action to heal the beast shape's HP (1d8 per spell slot level).

features.name: Nature's Talon
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, when you are in beast shape, your attacks are considered magical for determining a target's immunity or resistance.

features.name: Shape of the Elements
features.description: By 10th level, when you use Wild Shape, you may expend an additional use to transform into a CR 5 elemental (air, earth, fire, or water) instead of a beast.

features.name: Multitude of Faces
features.description: Starting at 14th level, your skinchanging powers are so potent that you can cast *alter self* at will.
